# Rules

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List rules

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/rules`

Retrieve a paginated list of rules with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: sourceLocation, destinationLocation, route, operationType, partnerAddress, warehouse, propagateWarehouse, company, creator | `route,operationType` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by | `architecto` |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by name | `Replenish` |
| `filter[action]` | string | No | Filter by action values | `pull` |
| `filter[source_location_id]` | string | No | Filter by source location IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[destination_location_id]` | string | No | Filter by destination location IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[route_id]` | string | No | Filter by route IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[operation_type_id]` | string | No | Filter by operation type IDs | `architecto` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-created_at` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/rules?include=route%2CoperationType&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=Replenish&filter%5Baction%5D=pull&filter%5Bsource_location_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Bdestination_location_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Broute_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Boperation_type_id%5D=architecto&sort=-created_at" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \

```

## Create rule

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/rules`

Create a new rule

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Rule name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `action` | string | Yes | Rule action. |
| `operation_type_id` | integer | Yes | Operation type ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `source_location_id` | integer | Yes | Source location ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `destination_location_id` | integer | Yes | Destination location ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `partner_address_id` | integer | No | Partner address ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `delay` | integer | No | Lead time in days. Must be at least 0. |
| `route_id` | integer | Yes | Route ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/rules" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "WH1: Stock -> Output",
  "action": "pull",
  "operation_type_id": 1,
  "source_location_id": 3,
  "destination_location_id": 4,
  "partner_address_id": 10,
  "delay": 1,
  "route_id": 1,
  "company_id": 1
}'
```
